main_measure.name: pooled mean of sign(forecast) x (10-bar forward return - coin holding mean) on |forecast|>=10, non-overlapping
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 and t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 and t <= -2; else inconclusive; needs >= 30 cases pooled and >= 10 per regime

supporting_check.name: per-regime signed excess return: trending mean=0.208191 t=1.313; mean_reversion mean=-0.024064 t=-0.528; value = smaller t

decided_by: Fewer than 30 non-overlapping cases in the pool.
reading: Holding is each coin's mean of all overlapping 10-bar forward returns across its windows. Cases are the window-grid bars 0, 10, 20, ... with |forecast| >= 10 and a full 10-bar return inside the window, split by the recorded regime label. The supporting check passes when both regimes have a positive mean and is not part of the decision.
